params.message:
Behind the link at the foot of a newsletter, readers choose which newsletters they get

The page that only unsubscribed now shows the two newsletters, Afrodidact and KUBO, ticked
as the person gets them. They can untick one, tick the other, or unsubscribe from both;
someone who had unsubscribed can tick one to come back, since the link came to their own
address. Opening the page still changes nothing. A call without a choice still
unsubscribes from everything.
